_note: E2E variant of llm-router.config.json. mac-custom (self-hosted on the user's Mac, no quota) is FIRST for daily dev/test E2E; gemini-openai stays for real-provider compatibility verification (thought_signature, RPD=20 — one session/day). dsh picks the chain via the model it requests (router routes by model name).

upstreams.name: mac-custom
upstreams._note: Flaky tunnel: first attempts may 502/408 — retry the request, it usually succeeds. No geminiThoughtSignatures (different protocol). MODEL DRIFT 2026-09-19: the Mac no longer serves oc/big-pickle (403 model-not-found); /v1/models there now offers prefixed ids. gemini/gemini-3.6-flash is verified on that endpoint with real tool_calls (probe: finish_reason=tool_calls, function copilot_ask). The prefix keeps this distinct from gemini-openai's bare `gemini-3.6-flash` — the router matches model names EXACTLY (llm-router.mjs candidates(): u.model === wantModel), so the two can never cross over.
